text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from shopping at night, I 
passed in front of a movie theater. Just 
then—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wooo! Made it in time for the late show! 
Mister, two student tickets, please!

text_block_list.name: Ticket Seller
text_block_list.text: Children aren't allowed in.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Who're ya callin' a kid, ya big dummy?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's watch it, Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Even if we're not children, I feel like 
watching this movie might be a bit 
impossible, dear...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Look, check the time. The dorm curfew... 
If we watch this and head back, we'll be 
late.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Curfew?! Gah!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, if we watch this, we're definitely 
blowing past it.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What should I do? The movie or curfew... 
which one do I pick...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Um... Tama-chan. I understand how you 
feel, but coming home late isn't good. So, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Nope, I'm watchin' it!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Huh... You're going to break curfew? 
Tama-chan, since when did you become such 
a bad girl...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Like I said, quit treatin' me like a kid! 
If it were any ordinary movie, sure. But 
look!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What we're watchin' tonight is 'Real 
Accounts: Showa Horse Girl Biographies'! 
This is something I gotta see right this 
second!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I don't mix up my priorities. Getting 
stronger is way more important than some 
curfew!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
For the things that really matter, I'll 
bust right through any restriction! I'll 
watch it alone if I have to!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Tama-chan... I can't let you go home all 
by yourself so late. In that case, I will 
also...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Hang on a sec. What's this, a message 
from the squirts...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Let's see... Wh-What did you say?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, guess it can't be helped. Sorry, 
Creek. No movie tonight.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tama-chan, is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nah, nothin' major. Just gotta follow the 
rules after all, haha. See ya!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* Man, what a mess. To think what I 
sent for Ma's birthday present wasn't 
enough...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If I send over my movie money too, it 
should work out somehow.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Alright, tap to send.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Countin' on ya, squirts... Make sure Pa 
and Ma are happy while I'm not around.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to see that movie, but... 
oh well! I'll never mix up what matters 
most.
